summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to publish a supplementary prospectus for its 40 billion Euro Medium Term Note Programme dated 5 December 2025. The filing is a routine debt-program update approved by the UK Financial Conduct Authority, not a special-situation event. No terms, prices, premiums, or strategic actions are involved — it is purely a regulatory disclosure for an existing note programme. This corresponds to a US shelf prospectus supplement, not a directed corporate event. No special-situation classification applies.
